title: Compliance Onramp: customer need mapping & SLA 'thermometer' for exception prioritization
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit heterogeneous security/compliance asks (SOC2 evidence requests, GDPR/DPA clauses, HIPAA questionnaires, vendor risk forms). These vary wildly in scope and expected effort and currently flow into a flat queue. PMs, Legal, and Solutions Engineering spend time manually interpreting context, estimating lead time, and negotiating SLAs. Outcome: slower response times, unpredictable SLAs, and higher operational cost.

Goal: Build a guided Compliance Onramp and an 'Exception Thermometer' UI that maps incoming customer requests to a risk+effort profile and produces an auto-estimated SLA tier and evidence-bundle template. The system should: 1) surface a guided intake form to gather canonical signals (data types, retention, region, regulated workload, required certifications); 2) enrich with account metadata (subscription tier, Dedicated/Private deployment, contract clauses); 3) compute a risk/effort score and suggested SLA bucket (Fast <7d, Standard 7-21d, Extended 21-60d, Escalate to Legal); 4) attach a suggested evidence template (SOC2 artifact list, HIPAA mappings, DPA clause language draft, vendor Qs prefilled answers) and an estimated engineering effort and owner; 5) route to the correct team lane (Solutions Eng, Legal, Compliance Ops) with a recommended follow-up cadence and fallback.

Scope: MVP covers SOC2 evidence requests, standard DPA clause exceptions, and common vendor questionnaire forms (SIG/CAIQ-lite). HIPAA and complex cross-border data residency exceptions are included as 'Elevate' flows (escalate to Legal/Compliance ops). The feature will live in the Console as an intake modal on the customer-facing Support/Trust page plus an internal intake UI for CSM/SE triage.
acceptance_criteria: Guided intake form captures canonical signals: dataset types, retention, processing location, model usage pattern, and requested compliance artifact
System computes a reproducible risk+effort score and maps to one of four SLA buckets with explanation text
Suggested evidence bundle or clause draft appears and can be exported as a downloadable ZIP or prefilled doc for Legal review
Routing rules send the request and metadata to the appropriate internal lane (SE/Legal/Compliance Ops) and create a Linear ticket if escalate rules apply
Console UI shows the 'Thermometer' visualization to customer-facing users and internal triagers, with estimated completion date and confidence level
Telemetry recorded: time-to-first-response estimate, actual completion time, revision count to final artifact, and customer satisfaction tag
implementation_steps: Design: finalize intake form fields and 'thermometer' UX copy (collaborate with Design and Legal)
Data: define canonical signal schema and mapping rules; add account enrichment hooks (billing tier, deployment type)
Rules: author initial risk/effort scoring heuristic and mapping to SLA buckets; document fallback/escalation thresholds
Templates: collate SOC2/HIPAA/DPA evidence templates and vendor questionnaire answer libraries; create templating endpoint
Routing: implement routing to lanes and Linear ticket creation for escalations (ENG integration)
Console: build intake modal + internal triage view + Thermometer panel with export action
Telemetry: wire events to the Console analytics and create dashboard prototype for SLA adherence
stakeholders: ENG-Serving-Runtime Team (for evidence export & routing integration)
